@Test
public void TestGetErrorMsg() {
    // missing select
    ParserError("c, b, c from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "c, b, c from t
" + "^
" + "Encountered: IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: ALTER, COMPUTE, CREATE, DESCRIBE, DROP, EXPLAIN, GRANT, " + "INSERT, INVALIDATE, LOAD, REFRESH, REVOKE, SELECT, SET, SHOW, TRUNCATE, " + "USE, VALUES, WITH
");
    // missing select list
    ParserError("select from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select from t
" + "       ^
" + "Encountered: FROM
" + "Expected: ALL, CASE, CAST, DISTINCT, EXISTS, " + "FALSE, IF, INTERVAL, NOT, NULL, " + "STRAIGHT_JOIN, TRUNCATE, TRUE, IDENTIFIER
");
    // missing from
    ParserError("select c, b, c where a = 5", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select c, b, c where a = 5
" + "               ^
" + "Encountered: WHERE
" + "Expected: AND, AS, BETWEEN, DIV, FROM, IN, IS, LIKE, LIMIT, NOT, OR, " + "ORDER, REGEXP, RLIKE, UNION, COMMA, IDENTIFIER
");
    // missing table list
    ParserError("select c, b, c from where a = 5", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select c, b, c from where a = 5
" + "                    ^
" + "Encountered: WHERE
" + "Expected: IDENTIFIER
");
    // missing predicate in where clause (no group by)
    ParserError("select c, b, c from t where", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select c, b, c from t where
" + "                           ^
" + "Encountered: EOF
" + "Expected: CASE, CAST, EXISTS, FALSE, " + "IF, INTERVAL, NOT, NULL, TRUNCATE, TRUE, IDENTIFIER
");
    // missing predicate in where clause (group by)
    ParserError("select c, b, c from t where group by a, b", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select c, b, c from t where group by a, b
" + "                            ^
" + "Encountered: GROUP
" + "Expected: CASE, CAST, EXISTS, FALSE, " + "IF, INTERVAL, NOT, NULL, TRUNCATE, TRUE, IDENTIFIER
");
    // unmatched string literal starting with "
    ParserError("select c, "b, c from t", "Unmatched string literal in line 1:
" + "select c, "b, c from t
" + "           ^
");
    // unmatched string literal starting with '
    ParserError("select c, 'b, c from t", "Unmatched string literal in line 1:
" + "select c, 'b, c from t
" + "           ^
");
    // test placement of error indicator ^ on queries with multiple lines
    ParserError("select (i + 5)(1 - i) from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select (i + 5)(1 - i) from t
" + "              ^
" + "Encountered: (
" + "Expected:");
    ParserError("select (i + 5)
(1 - i) from t", "Syntax error in line 2:
" + "(1 - i) from t
" + "^
" + "Encountered: (
" + "Expected");
    ParserError("select (i + 5)
(1 - i)
from t", "Syntax error in line 2:
" + "(1 - i)
" + "^
" + "Encountered: (
" + "Expected");
    // Long line: error in the middle
    ParserError("select c, b, c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,a a a,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,cd,c,d,d,,c, from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "... b, c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,a a a,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,cd,c,d,d,,c,...
" + "                             ^
" + "Encountered: IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: CROSS, FROM, FULL, GROUP, HAVING, INNER, JOIN, LEFT, LIMIT, OFFSET, " + "ON, ORDER, RIGHT, UNION, USING, WHERE, COMMA
");
    // Long line: error close to the start
    ParserError("select a a a, b, c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,cd,c,d,d,,c, from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "select a a a, b, c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,...
" + "           ^
" + "Encountered: IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: CROSS, FROM, FULL, GROUP, HAVING, INNER, JOIN, LEFT, LIMIT, OFFSET, " + "ON, ORDER, RIGHT, UNION, USING, WHERE, COMMA
");
    // Long line: error close to the end
    ParserError("select a, b, c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,cd,c,d,d, ,c, from t", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "...c,c,c,c,c,c,c,c,cd,c,d,d, ,c, from t
" + "                             ^
" + "Encountered: COMMA
" + "Expected: CASE, CAST, EXISTS, FALSE, " + "IF, INTERVAL, NOT, NULL, TRUNCATE, TRUE, IDENTIFIER
");
    // Parsing identifiers that have different names printed as EXPECTED
    ParserError("DROP DATA SRC foo", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "DROP DATA SRC foo
" + "          ^
" + "Encountered: IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: SOURCE
");
    ParserError("SHOW DATA SRCS", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "SHOW DATA SRCS
" + "          ^
" + "Encountered: IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: SOURCES
");
    ParserError("USE ` `", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "USE ` `
" + "    ^
" + "Encountered: EMPTY IDENTIFIER
" + "Expected: IDENTIFIER
");
    // Expecting = token
    ParserError("SET foo", "Syntax error in line 1:
" + "SET foo
" + "       ^
" + "Encountered: EOF
" + "Expected: =
");
}
